event.felix_heart2.4.text: You should've seen the other one. There's always another one. Though lately the pond's been stingy with its mornings. Quiet ones. A fisher notices.
event.felix_heart2.4.why: the quiet-dawn fear surfaces as noticing

event.felix_heart5.1.text: It was mine. It's yours now. You've the look of thin ice about you lately. Carry the luck. I'll carry the bait.
event.felix_heart5.1.why: the charm becomes comfort for a frightened player

event.past_the_point.0.text: There you are. The boat I promised. She floats. I checked twice. Odd sea this morning, mind. Flat as a plate, and no smell to it. Tin's the elegant part.
event.past_the_point.0.why: the sea losing its smell, per the unaware list

event.story_whistler_felix.after.text: Same hour tomorrow, same lane, same tune. Folk here go in early after dark. More lane for us. You can pretend you were passing.
event.story_whistler_felix.after.why: hint tier: the early-indoors custom, unexplained

event.festival_winter_lanterns.2.text: Mine's this big. Last winter it was this big. Wishes grow, like fish. Hope it climbs quick. The sky looks heavy tonight.
event.festival_winter_lanterns.2.why: the sky waiting, read as weather

event.felix_heart8.intro.text: Quiet, now. The pond's held its breath all week. Something's down there, deciding. It's on the line this minute. Take the net. Don't breathe.
event.felix_heart8.intro.why: echoes heart2's 'deciding'; the pond gets agency

dlg.felix.big.0.text: Something very large tugs on Felix's line. It might be a fish. It might be the pond, pulling back.
dlg.felix.big.0.why: frightened narration: the bottom becomes a will

event.felix_birthday.intro.text: My birthday. Tilda outlawed fishing till noon. She brought a pie. I brought a story. It's about a fish. ...The gulls skipped the crumbs this year. First time ever.
event.felix_birthday.intro.why: birds quieter, kept as birthday small talk

event.felix_courtship.intro.text: Mornin'. No. Not just mornin'. You've been carrying something heavy, I can see it. I'd like to stand nearer while you carry it. Would you court me? Slowly, like the tide.
event.felix_courtship.intro.why: unaware comfort: the ask becomes shelter, same meaning

dlg.felix.partners.r2.text: The sun comes up. It always has so far. We won't say much. That's the whole plan.
dlg.felix.partners.r2.why: dry fisher's joke that reads as mood

event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l2.text: It's a bigger carp. It grew. In the bucket, overnight. ...I didn't care to watch it happen.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l2.why: odd shapes; Tilda's disbelief still lands

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l1.text: Dawn's too quiet lately. Even the gulls. Count your stitches loud as you like.
event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l1.why: complaint turns invitation; her reply still fits

adds.text: ...You look wrung out, friend. Sit a spell. The tide doesn't mind company.
adds.why: fills the silence left by cutting the tall tale

adds.text: Your uncle sat this rock, some dawns. Never cast a line. Just watched the tree line, like it owed him something.
adds.why: my one clue: Edmund on the rock, memory not meaning

cuts.why: the tall tale falls flat on a frightened player; the add covers the gap

notes: I am unaware: every variant is weather, birds, water, fish; nothing explained, no suspicion. The Edmund rock memory (heart5 add) is my only clue and stays a memory.
felix_heart8 variants say 'pond', matching shipped dlg.felix.big.0; the Beach-vs-pond map question from r2 is still the Director's to settle.
Locked hinges untouched: 'test it', 'Don't tell the pond', 'friends', the pencil stroke, elara_2 'tell'.
The heart2 cut removes the catchphrase only at dread>=60, paired with the comfort add; the uneasy variant of .4 covers dread 30-59.
overheard_tilda_felix_1 variant keeps the price-justifying job so Tilda's 'Your prices have' still lands.
